static_checks.subject: Scope
static_checks.evidence: Exactly the four authorized files changed from CP02; no Cargo.lock, language IR/schema, budget, frontend/Verify, target partition or publication source change.

static_checks.subject: Single actual pass recipe
static_checks.evidence: Optimization::pipeline returns static CStr O0=default<O0>,function(mem2reg) and O2=default<O2>. native compile_input uses that accessor for LLVMRunPasses and receipt.pipeline; PreparedCache uses the same Config optimization accessor.

static_checks.subject: Codegen target and option preservation
static_checks.evidence: TargetMachine generic x86-64 CPU, empty features, codegen optlevel 0/2, PIC/default code model, data-layout checks, LLVM version pin and pass-builder vectorization settings are byte-for-byte unaffected by the diff.

static_checks.subject: Verification, cancellation and error flow
static_checks.evidence: native.rs changes only pipeline selection. Structured machine preflight, LLVM Verify before and after, cooperative cancellation points, error categories/message disposal and RAII owned-handle lifetime remain unchanged. Driver independent ZIL Verify is outside the diff.

static_checks.subject: Cache identity and publication
static_checks.evidence: Private action_namespace retains exact compiler identity, LLVM DSO identity, version, target fingerprint, optimization level and all fixed-setting tags. It moves protocol 212-v1 to 212-v2 and adds the actual recipe bytes. Trusted-directory checks, payload/key integrity, current hit preflight, pending success-only cache commit and artifact publication are unaffected.

static_checks.subject: Recipe isolation test
static_checks.evidence: New cache test fixes compiler/library identities, version, target, O0 level and machine module, varies only recipe, and asserts namespace and machine action key differ. Test injection is a private helper argument; production always calls the actual shared accessor.

static_checks.subject: Timing and artifact claims
static_checks.evidence: Existing llvm_optimize span and receipt optimize_ns bracket the actual LLVMRunPasses including mem2reg; object emit remains separate. Driver test explicitly calls .ll a pre-pass sidecar and does not claim it is post-pass evidence.

static_checks.subject: Real-source differential design
static_checks.evidence: Four source tests cover runtime loop/branch merges, actual callback addresses with sequential reborrows, existing field_exit cleanup with fixed output oracles, and checked overflow SIGILL. Each compares Clang O0, API O0 one CGU, API O0 actual multiple CGUs, and API O2; it checks current ZIL Verify count, real Builder receipts, disabled object cache, and exact expected exit/stdout/stderr.
